title: How should furnace and load temperatures be recorded in a box furnace?
summary: When two recorder types are supplied, first identify their sensor inputs. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s two box-furnace proposals dated 11 April 2022 cover 180 kW and 130 kW units, with a paper recorder for control points and a six-channel paperless recorder for workpiece-monitoring points. Compare sensors, channels and measured objects first. “Dual recording” does not automatically mean backup data or verified workpiece temperature.
